description: This file defines a TokenCache class used for managing OpenID Connect tokens (access token, refresh token, IDP info) within the MongoDB driver. It includes methods for retrieving, storing, and removing tokens, and handles errors related to missing tokens.

classes.name: TokenCache
classes.description: A class for caching and managing OIDC tokens (access token, refresh token, IDP info) for MongoDB driver authentication.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Returns the stored access token or throws an error if none is present.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Returns the stored refresh token or throws an error if none is present.

methods.name: getIdpInfo
methods.description: Returns the stored IDP information or throws an error if none is present.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores new tokens and IDP info into the cache based on an OIDC response.
